name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Fix silent deploy/preview failure: implicit Enter-key form submission (from a typeahead pick or any text field) activated no button, so action= was omitted entirely and the server silently no-op'd with no error. Typeahead Enter handlers now always preventDefault, and a form-wide guard blocks implicit Enter-submission from plain text fields. Added a server-side fallback message for defense in depth.
Persist post-deploy/preview flash messages in Postgres (keyed by channel slug) instead of Flask session, since AudioMuse's host app doesn't reliably issue session cookies for plugin routes.
